updates.title: CVE-2026-62916: Microsoft Entra ID Elevation of Privilege Vulnerability
updates.summary: An authentication bypass vulnerability in Microsoft Entra ID allows unauthorized attackers to elevate privileges over a network. Admins should prioritize patching to prevent unauthorized access escalation in their identity infrastructure.

updates.title: CVE-2026-83941: Entra ID Elevation of Privilege Vulnerability
updates.summary: A missing authorization flaw in Entra ID permits authorized attackers to escalate privileges across the network. Organizations should apply security updates to prevent privilege escalation attacks from compromised accounts.

updates.title: CVE-2026-69524: Active Directory Domain Services Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
updates.summary: A use-after-free vulnerability in Active Directory Domain Services enables unauthorized attackers to execute arbitrary code remotely. This is a critical vulnerability for on-premises AD environments and requires immediate patching.

updates.title: CVE-2026-69359: Active Directory Domain Services Elevation of Privilege Vulnerability
updates.summary: A heap-based buffer overflow in Active Directory Domain Services allows authorized attackers to elevate privileges locally on domain controllers. Admins should patch affected systems to prevent local privilege escalation attacks.

updates.title: CVE-2026-70178: Microsoft Fabric Elevation of Privilege Vulnerability
updates.summary: Missing authorization controls in Microsoft Fabric allow authorized attackers to escalate privileges across the network. Organizations using Fabric for data governance should apply updates to maintain proper access controls.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview Data Lifecycle Management: Secure Workflow to Bypass Legal Holds and Retention Policies
updates.summary: A new Priority cleanup feature introduces a controlled exception workflow allowing admins to delete items under broader retention policies and legal holds on Exchange, requiring multiple approvers and creating a complete audit trail. This addresses compliance scenarios where exceptions are necessary while maintaining governance controls.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Integration with Entra Global Secure Access for Network-Layer Sensitive File Filtering
updates.summary: Microsoft Purview DLP policies now extend to the network layer through integration with Entra Global Secure Access Internet Access, enabling file inspection and enforcement against untrusted cloud apps, generative AI platforms, and SaaS services. This provides an additional control point to prevent sensitive data exfiltration outside of Microsoft 365.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Data Loss Prevention for Microsoft Cowork
updates.summary: DLP policies now extend to Microsoft Cowork, protecting sensitive data in AI interactions by blocking labeled knowledge sources and restricted prompts. This unifies data protection across Microsoft 365 Copilot and Cowork in a single policy framework.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Data Lifecycle Management - Retention Based on Last Accessed for OneDrive and SharePoint
updates.summary: Admins can now apply retention labels and policies to OneDrive and SharePoint items based on their last-access date, enabling more granular lifecycle management of stale content. This improves data governance by automatically managing dormant files without manual intervention.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Data Lifecycle Management - Automated Deletion of Inactive OneDrives and Mailboxes for Departed Employees
updates.summary: A new capability enables admins to automatically delete both content and containers for departed users at scale, ensuring tenant compliance without manual effort. This simplifies the offboarding process while maintaining regulatory requirements.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Data Lifecycle Management - Insights and Policy Recommendations on Sensitive Data
updates.summary: Admins now receive insights on sensitive M365 data in OneDrive and SharePoint with policy recommendations to improve data governance and compliance posture. This AI-driven guidance helps teams proactively address retention gaps for sensitive information.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Data Lifecycle Management - Apply Retention Policy to Microsoft Planner Content
updates.summary: Admins can now create retention policies for Microsoft Planner content and tasks associated with Microsoft 365 Groups, extending data lifecycle management to collaboration tools. This ensures compliance and governance coverage across the entire M365 collaboration stack.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Endpoint Data Loss Prevention – Device Health Reporting Dashboard
updates.summary: A new device health dashboard displays the status of all endpoints to verify system readiness and identify devices not ready for policy updates. This monitoring capability helps admins maintain a healthy DLP deployment across their fleet.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Data Loss Prevention for Non-Microsoft Connected Apps
updates.summary: DLP policies now protect sensitive data at rest in non-Microsoft connected applications including Box and Google Workspace using existing Microsoft Defender for Cloud Apps connectors. This extends security governance to third-party SaaS platforms with the same classification engine.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Sensitivity Labels - Auto-Labeling Policy Simulation Mode
updates.summary: Auto-labeling policies can now run in simulation mode to preview labeling matches without enforcing changes, with an Insights tab showing policy performance. Admins can validate policy behavior before enforcement to ensure accuracy and reduce noise.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Auto-Labeling Policies for Non-Microsoft Connected Apps
updates.summary: Auto-labeling policies now extend to non-Microsoft connected applications such as Box and Google Workspace, using Microsoft Defender for Cloud Apps connectors and the same classification engine. This enables consistent sensitivity labeling across third-party platforms.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Data Loss Prevention Policy Change Insights with Security Copilot
updates.summary: Security Copilot now summarizes DLP policies and provides insights on coverage across locations, classifiers, and notifications, allowing admins to use natural language prompts for deeper configuration analysis. This AI-driven capability helps teams align their data posture and identify policy gaps.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Endpoint Data Loss Prevention - Archive File Classification Behavior Change
updates.summary: Archive file classification behavior on Windows endpoints is being updated to align with cloud workloads, improving consistency and reducing noise in event reporting while enhancing performance. Admins should review their DLP policies to ensure expected behavior with archived content.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Data Lifecycle Management - Billing Model Change
updates.summary: DLM billing is transitioning from per-policy to volume-based pricing at $0.25 per GB per month for retained data, including generative AI prompts and responses. Organizations should review their DLM usage patterns to understand cost implications of the new pricing model.
